theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  have key : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℚ := 
    Rat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow n (ne_of_even hn)
  rw [key]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x
    rcases AddSubmonoid.mem_closure_nneg ℤ x with ⟨a, ha⟩
    use a
    exact ha
  · intro x
    rcases AddSubmonoid.mem_nneg ℤ x with ⟨a, ha⟩
    use a
    exact ha
